name: Maya 2 Native

lineage.how_derived: Qwen3-1.7B backbone predicting Mimi codec tokens (32 codebooks, 12.5 Hz) with ECAPA speaker encoder

purpose: Open-weight streaming TTS for 11 Indian languages plus English: voice agents, IVR, accessibility, narration; 20 built-in voices, zero-shot cloning, cross-lingual synthesis (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (components have own licences per card)
license.notes: LICENSE file in repo is the Apache License 2.0 (header opened); the card points to a component-licences section (Mimi codec, ECAPA encoder) that I did not read.

architecture.kind: LLM-backbone TTS: Qwen3-1.7B-Base predicting Mimi tokens, 24 kHz, streaming; NVIDIA GPU for the shipped engine

pc-12gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (9.6 GB)

pc-16gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (13.6 GB)

pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.notes: 5.1 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 5.1 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 5.1 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

other: maya2-native inference engine: Python API, OpenAI-compatible speech endpoint, WebSocket streaming, continuous batching (NVIDIA GPU)

benchmarks.name: VoiceArena Hindi TTS leaderboard (real-time only filter), Elo
benchmarks.harness: card reproduces the leaderboard snapshot; all-model Hindi view places it #7 (interval 5-10); live check 2026-11-03 per card

strengths: Indian-language coverage with number/date/currency text normalisation

tona_fit.reason: No German or major EU language; purpose-built for Indian languages. Useful only as a model for adding an Indic profile later.

sources.note: leaderboard cited by the card; not opened

open_questions: Leaderboard page not opened by us
